A1.justification: The comparison could not be completed: local commands to read the PDF skill and extract the supplied PDFs stalled without returning document content. Neither PDF, including its appendices, could be inspected, so comparability and material completeness remain unresolved.

before.justification: The contents of v1.pdf were unavailable for inspection, preventing verification of original empirical results.

after.justification: The contents of v2.pdf were unavailable for inspection, preventing verification of original empirical results.

M1.justification: Unavailable method descriptions and equations prevent determining whether the proposed procedure changed.

E1.justification: Neither version's experiments could be inspected to establish dataset, task, or test-scenario coverage.

E2.justification: The reported comparisons were unavailable, preventing verification of baseline membership in corresponding experiments.

E3.justification: Experimental settings could not be read, so protocol changes cannot be distinguished from retained or newly disclosed settings.

E4.justification: The main text and appendices were unavailable, preventing comparison of ablations, robustness tests, and supplementary analyses.

E5.justification: Repeated-run information and statistical reporting could not be inspected in either version.

E6.justification: No result tables, figures, or findings could be inspected to match conditions and verify numerical or qualitative changes.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions, assumptions, derivations, and proofs could not be inspected or compared.

C1.justification: Neither version's abstract, introduction, or conclusion could be read to establish changes in core claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations were unavailable, preventing assessment of substantive changes.

D1.justification: Technical details and reproducibility disclosures could not be inspected in either PDF.

R1.justification: Related-work discussions and references were unavailable, preventing comparison of citations and research positioning.

P1.justification: Document text and section organization could not be inspected, so the extent of rewriting or restructuring is unknown.

P2.justification: Neither PDF could be visually inspected, preventing comparison of figures, tables, and layout.

improvement.justification: No document evidence was available to establish benefits, harms, or stability in overall quality. These uncertainty judgments reflect failed local access, not evidence that content was absent or unchanged.
